name: Loki + Grafana
description: Grafana Loki log aggregation, pre-wired as a Grafana data source for exploring logs.

source.name: Grafana Loki official documentation (docker-compose quickstart pattern)
source.license: Apache-2.0 (documentation/compose pattern); the Loki and Grafana server images themselves are AGPL-3.0

notes: Loki runs in single-binary filesystem mode. Ship logs to it with Promtail/Alloy or the Docker driver; the Loki data source is pre-provisioned in Grafana at http://loki:3100.
